heroNote: A charting hit from Talking Heads' 1980 album Remain In Light, Once In A Lifetime achieved #91 on the Billboard Hot 100 in 1986. Its enduring legacy is reflected in its platinum certification in the UK and inclusion in major music lists.

chapters.title: Chart History
chapters.body: Peaked at #91 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 4 weeks on the chart.

chapters.title: Music Video Legacy
chapters.body: The music video was named the 81st-best in its category.
chapters.whyIncluded: Highlights the visual impact of the song

chapters.title: Cultural Impact
chapters.body: Certified platinum in the UK in 2023, named one of the 500 Songs that Shaped Rock and Roll, and ranked #28 on Rolling Stone's 500 Greatest Songs of All Time.
sourceMaterial: Still Showing Up in Pop Culture

chapters.title: Album Context
chapters.body: Released in 1980 as part of the critically acclaimed album Remain In Light, which was recorded in the Bahamas and New York.
chapters.whyIncluded: Connects the song to its original album and recording locations

chapters.title: Talking Heads' Legacy
chapters.body: A defining track from the band's innovative career, contributing to their reputation as pioneers of new wave and art rock.
chapters.whyIncluded: Highlights the song's role in the band's artistic identity
